description: Start an Airlock Monitor run (RLS audit + DAST) on a connected project. Returns the run id and initial status. Poll with get_monitor_run.

api_key.description: Airlock Monitor API key (starts with amk_).

base_url.description: Base URL of the Monitor instance (default: https://app.shipsealed.com).

project_id.description: The project id to run against (from list_monitor_projects).

name: start_monitor_run
